name: grafana-devops-observability-dashboard
description: Pixel-perfect replica of Grafana DevOps Observability Dashboard with real-time simulations and interactive drilldowns

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'), fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); const mime = {'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'text/javascript','.json':'application/json','.svg':'image/svg+xml'}; http.createServer((req, res) => { let p = path.join(__dirname, req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url); fs.readFile(p, (err, data) => { if(err) { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found'); return; } res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': mime[path.extname(p)] || 'text/plain'}); res.end(data); }); }).listen(3000, () => console.log('Dashboard ready at http://localhost:3000'));"

author: Antigravity
